profile: Two mismatched companions are forced to cross the country together by car, bus and train, bickering the whole way. One is uptight, the other a loudmouth, and the long journey through motels and highways slowly turns irritation into real friendship. Warm, quick-witted and full of escalating mishaps.

A sharp, underestimated attorney takes on a case nobody thinks can be won. Most of the tension plays out in front of a judge and jury: cross-examinations, surprise witnesses and a closing argument that turns the verdict. Dialogue-driven legal drama about truth versus procedure.

A crew of specialists, each with one perfect skill, plans an elaborate robbery of a vault everyone says is impossible to crack. Meticulous planning montages, a double-cross, and a stylish, tense execution where everything goes wrong at once.

A protagonist is thrown into the past or the future and has to stop changing history for the worse. Paradoxes, meeting younger versions of people they know, and a race to get back before the present is erased.

A bleak future society run by an all-seeing authoritarian regime that controls what people think, read and feel. One citizen starts to question the system and becomes a hunted rebel. Oppressive, grey, paranoid atmosphere.

A shy high schooler drifts through one transformative summer: first love, a falling-out with a best friend, parents who don't understand, and the painful discovery of who they really are. Nostalgic, bittersweet and funny.

A family moves into an old mansion with a grim past, and strange things begin at night: doors opening on their own, whispers in the walls, a presence in the cellar. Slow-burn supernatural dread that builds to full terror.

The dead rise and the infection spreads through a city in days. A small group of survivors barricades itself in, scavenges for supplies and fights off shambling, flesh-eating hordes while turning on each other.

A weary investigator and a young partner hunt a methodical murderer who leaves elaborate clues at each grisly scene. Rain-soaked city, cat-and-mouse psychology, and a dread-filled final confrontation.

The rise and fall of a criminal family that runs its neighbourhood through loyalty, fear and violence. Sit-down meetings, betrayals between brothers, and a young heir pulled into the business he swore he'd avoid.

A ragtag team of misfits nobody believes in is coached by a washed-up has-been toward a championship. Training montages, a humiliating early loss, and a final game decided in the last seconds. Uplifting and rousing.

Two Manhattan singles who can't stand each other keep running into each other in cafés, bookstores and on snowy streets, until banter turns into love. Charming, witty and cosy, with a big-gesture finale.

A hacker in a neon-lit, rain-drenched megacity discovers that the digital world people plug their minds into hides a terrible secret. Corporations rule, bodies are augmented with implants, and the line between simulation and the real blurs.

Creatures who speak and have big personalities go on a colourful adventure to get home or save their friends. Bright, playful family entertainment with slapstick, songs and a gentle lesson about belonging.

A savage, deadpan send-up of power and stupidity, where the funniest moments are also the most horrifying. Bureaucrats, generals or executives make absurd decisions with catastrophic consequences, and the film never asks you to like anyone.

Intelligence agents from rival superpowers play a patient, paranoid game of double agents, dead drops and defections in grey 1960s Europe. Quiet, cerebral espionage where trust is the most dangerous weapon.

A disorienting puzzle of a story where nothing is what it seems: unreliable memories, a fractured timeline and a final revelation that recasts everything you've watched. You'll want to rewatch it immediately.

Stranded alone in a frozen, remote landscape after a disaster, one person must find food, shelter and a way out while nature tries to kill them. Sparse dialogue, physical endurance and grim determination.

The true life story of a gifted performer from humble beginnings to fame, with addiction, broken relationships and a comeback. Concert recreations, recording-studio breakthroughs, and the cost of genius.
A disciplined fighter trained since childhood must use their skills against a ruthless gang to avenge their master. Elaborately choreographed hand-to-hand combat, tournaments and training sequences.
Two lovable, perpetually high slackers set out on a simple errand that spirals into an absurd all-night odyssey. Dopey humour, paranoid misunderstandings and the munchies.
A fighter past their prime gets one last shot at a title bout. Bloody sparring, a gruff trainer, early-morning runs and a brutal final match where every punch hurts.
A crew trapped in a steel vessel deep beneath the ocean during wartime, hunted by enemy destroyers. Claustrophobic tension, depth charges, failing systems and tough decisions about who survives.
Swashbuckling adventure on the high seas: buccaneers, cursed treasure, ship-to-ship cannon battles and sword fights in the rigging. Rollicking, roguish and full of double-crosses.
A charming grifter and an apprentice run elaborate scams on greedy marks, layering cons within cons until you can't tell who is fooling whom. Slick, playful and full of reveals.
An eccentric community in an out-of-the-way rural place where everyone knows everyone, full of oddball characters and deadpan jokes. Gentle, offbeat and affectionate.
A middle-aged man, bored with his marriage and career, abruptly blows up his comfortable life chasing youth: a new car, an affair, a rash career change. Funny and painful in equal measure.
Young soldiers drafted into a jungle conflict in Southeast Asia lose their innocence amid ambushes, napalm and moral collapse. A harrowing, hallucinatory portrait of the late 1960s.

A machine with a mind of its own starts to think, feel and want things its creators never intended. Is it a person? Quiet, unsettling science fiction about consciousness, control and what makes us human.
Prehistoric creatures brought back to life or discovered in a lost world run rampant, and humans become prey. Thrilling creature effects, jungle chases and spectacle.
